add_definitions(-D_PROPSYS_)
spec2def(propsys.dll propsys.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# propsys.dll is all Rust (propsys-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/propsys-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# propstore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/propsys-rust/src/propsys/propstore.rs)
# propsys_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/propsys-rust/src/propsys/propsys_main.rs)
# propvar.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/propsys-rust/src/propsys/propvar.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(propsys_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(propsys_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register libole32 liboleaut32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(propsys_shims)
add_cargo_module(propsys propsys-cargo propsys.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE propsys-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS propsys_shims psdk uuid_sources)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
